links.kind: New D5 construction; all thirteen historical D4 seeds retained without selection. Does not replace the n47..51 frontier panel.

question: Can checked degree-four seed quotients yield independently accepted degree-five certificates with codimension exceeding freshly counted solutions on the thirteen historical inputs?

claims.text: An independently accepted D5 certificate whose checked codimension exceeds the freshly enumerated solution count certifies LFD >=6 for the exact named Boolean presentation.

arms.description: Native quotient lift, followed by the unchanged independent certificate checker when a candidate map is emitted.
Fresh exhaustive Boolean solution count for every input; m2 uses count_by_sum, chained t3 uses s3c3count. This is an executed reference stage, not an invented checker run.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact deterministic algebra and counts; no runtime comparison. Different chunk sizes are covered by software fixtures.

positive.not_applicable_reason: 144 full-space software fixtures, four Semaev independent-checker fixtures, and an end-to-end retained pipeline control passed before the historical trial. These are software validation records, not extra scientific arms.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Four corrupt constant maps were rejected; memory refusals and the equal-count/codimension no-bound case were checked. A killed constant yields unknown, not a negative mathematical conclusion.

factors.name: input
factors.how: All thirteen exact retained parameter records and D4 certificate hashes.

factors.name: instrument
factors.how: Committed producer/driver/checker source hashes and three native binary hashes pinned in lift-plan.json.

factors.name: host
factors.how: Existing shared host; one extra process with at most16 GiB and one thread. Existing two40 GiB workers remain separate; no timing claim.

factors.name: order
factors.how: Frozen historical plan order; one worker, completed results reused by matching plan hash.

factors.name: stage
factors.how: Producer and exact-count stages both execute for every input. Independent checker is conditional on an emitted certificate, not a separate rectangular arm.

comparisons.threshold: Original checker accepts degree5, fresh exact count agrees with recorded historical count, and count is strictly smaller than checked codimension.

randomization.arm_order_reason: Exact named-input replay has no arm-dependent clock inference.

seed_derivation.note: No new random inputs; seed is a run identifier only.

instance_sampling.rule: All thirteen historical inputs, each with a unique D5-lift01 output identity and original seed_id; no selection based on profile or lift outcome.

blinding.how: Historical outcomes known; no statistical comparison.

power.note: Exhaustive historical list, deterministic verification, no population or power claim.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Per-command watchdog only; scientific runtime is unmeasured and this allowance is not a prediction.

primary.name: accepted D5 codimension lower bound
primary.definition: nq only after original independent checker acceptance; absent if no accepted certificate.

secondary.name: exhaustive Boolean solution count
secondary.definition: Fresh count from the pinned native counter; no copied historical value is a new measurement.

placement.checkpoint_detail: Each completed attempt is immutable and reusable after hash checks. Native elimination has no process checkpoint; interrupted attempts remain and a retry uses a new attempt directory.

stopping_rules.rule: Attempt all thirteen seeds once in plan order; no outcome-driven replacement. Explicit infrastructure retries preserve old attempts.
Resource refusal, timeout, invalid certificate or counter failure is retained without an LFD inference.

invalidation_rules: Seed acceptance receipt or hash mismatch prevents execution.
Any failed independent checker prevents a certified claim.
Count mismatch with historical record requires investigation before an LFD inference.
Killing 1 in an over-approximating quotient is not a refutation of W5 nonmembership.

decision_rule.text: Only the conjunction of accepted certificate and strictly smaller verified exact count establishes LFD>=6.

outputs: per-attempt producer and checker logs, fresh counts, certificates and conditional LFD lower bounds

graphs: Per-instance D5 outcomes with unknown cells explicit; no runtime graph

inadmissible: Calling projection_kills_one a proved upper bound.
Calling native output a certificate before original checker acceptance.
Inferring LFD>=6 without the count inequality.
Replacing missing frontier n47..51 results with these historical trials.

literature.claim: Constructive quotient-lift rationale, source review and remaining validation requirements.
